scripts.dev: pnpm run build:css && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --env development --port 5401 --inspector-port 9401 --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: pnpm run build:css && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --env development --local --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:css && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:upload: pnpm run build:css && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler versions upload --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.upload:ci: pnpm run build:css && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler versions upload --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:ci: pnpm run build:css && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run test
scripts.check:generated: pnpm run cf-typegen && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareBindings --check
scripts.check:static: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:types && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip
